title: Two's complement explorer

milestone.title: Binary: The Language of the Machine

description:
Show how negative numbers are stored in 8 bits.

```
Number (-128 to 127): -5
5 in binary:      00000101
flip the bits:    11111010
add one:          11111011
-5 is stored as 11111011 (251 if read as unsigned)
```
hints: `n & 0xFF` gives the 8-bit pattern of a negative number directly; use it to check your three steps (lesson 2.05).
Flipping the bits of `x` in 8 bits is `x ^ 0b11111111`.
requirements: For negative numbers, show the three steps; for positive numbers, show the bits only.
Show the unsigned reading of the same bits.
stretch: Show what happens when 127 + 1 is stored in 8 bits.
